newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuban foreign minister to visit Japan this week.
newsitem.headline: Cuban foreign minister to visit Japan this week.

text.p: Cuban Foreign Minister Roberto Robaina will visit Japan on Thursday and Friday at the end of an Asian trip, official media said on Monday.

Japanese media had already announced Robaina would visit Tokyo in mid-April but the Cuban Foreign Ministry had declined to confirm it, saying the minister's official programme in Asia consisted of visits to India, Singapore, Malaysia and Brunei.

The trade union newspaper Trabajadores said Robaina would meet his Japanese counterpart Yukihiho Ikeda but did not give further details. Japanese media this month said Robaina would discuss with Japanese officials Cuba's offer of asylum to Peruvian rebels holding 72 hostages at the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima.
